Help.Title: KeeStashDock — User guide
Help.Content:
## What is KeeStashDock
A lightweight text dock: stash snippets from anywhere, find them instantly, and act on selected text in any application. Everything lives in a portable Data folder next to the app - no installation.

## Quick panel
Press the global hotkey (default Alt+Q, changeable in Settings) to show the panel. Type in the quick input and press Enter to stash; type in the search box to filter; click a card to copy it back to the clipboard. Each stash can carry an expiry: never, 1 day, 7 days, or burn after read - expired snippets move to the trash automatically. Press Alt+Enter or Shift+Enter to add a new line in the quick input.

## Pinning
Click a card's pin to keep it at hand: the pin turns solid and accent-colored. Click again to unpin. The workbench's Pinned view collects them all.

## Selection bubble
Settings > Behavior offers Copy only, Translate only, or Copy and translate. The combined mode shows two independent buttons. Copy creates a dock entry; Translate does not. After copying, Translate can reuse the same text until the bubble closes. While the bubble is visible, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C copies and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+T translates if those shortcuts are available. Neither action takes focus from the source application.

## Selection translate
The translation appears on a glass card; click the card to copy it. New installations use Bing (China), which needs no key. Google and Lingva also need no key; DeepL needs your own API key; Baidu uses its official API and requires your own App ID and secret key, with free usage subject to your account quota. Existing provider settings are kept; choose another engine in Settings if needed. Free services are not guaranteed to remain available. Selected text is sent only to the chosen provider, including Baidu; there is no automatic switch to another provider. Credentials are saved in local settings.

Requires an activated Alibaba Cloud Machine Translation service and your own AccessKey ID and secret. Free monthly quota and overage billing follow your account's rules. Install or repair offline translation in Settings > Optional components. The first download needs Internet access; afterwards the local service starts automatically when needed. Text stays on this computer. Only loopback addresses are accepted; the included models support Chinese and English.

## Bubble appearance
Bubble style: Default (soft black & white - white surface, black ink), Follow theme, or one of ten pinned palettes (Ivory, Graphite, ...). Text glow and drop shadow toggle independently; the opacity slider at 100% makes the glass fully opaque, curing any bleed-through.

## Clipboard history
Off by default. Enable it under Settings > Behavior and every text copy in any application lands as a snippet (source: clipboard). Switching it off stops collection instantly. Empty and oversized content is skipped; a duplicate merely bumps the existing snippet to the top.

## Direct paste
Off by default. When on, clicking a card also pastes it straight into the window you came from - no manual switch-and-Ctrl+V.

## Workbench
The panel's expand button opens the workbench: browse All / Pinned / groups / Trash, full-text search, and edit title, body, and comma-separated tags in place. Right-click a group to rename it, delete it (snippets move to Uncategorized), or delete it with contents (snippets go to the trash, recoverable). The Transform menu offers UPPER/lower case, whitespace collapse, line-break removal, JSON formatting, and URL/Base64 encode-decode.

## Group import/export and presets
Groups export as .ksdgrp files and import on another machine, with overwrite-or-rename on name conflicts. Preset groups import seven command collections in one click: Git, Docker, Linux Shell, PowerShell, npm/Node.js, Python/pip, and SQL.

## Sticky notes and QR
Drag a card from the panel onto the desktop to tear it out as a floating sticky note (opacity adjustable). Right-click a card to generate a QR code and take the text with your phone camera (up to 1800 characters).

## Appearance
Light / dark / follow-system theme; an optional panel background image with adjustable scrim and frosted glass. Text color schemes: Auto derives readable colors from your wallpaper region by region; presets and Custom (with a color picker) force one palette everywhere.

Panel mode in Settings > Appearance switches immediately between Classic (the default) and Floating depth. Both have surface and card shadows; Floating depth adds restrained hover, press, and drag feedback. Windows animation and high-contrast preferences take priority. Floating mode offers Fixed perspective or Drag to inspect. Hold and drag the right button by default; Settings also offers middle-button or custom gestures. Release to keep the angle; a plain right-click keeps the card menu. Cards respond in both views. The compact bar keeps six actions and restores the previous size. Optional edge auto-hide leaves a small handle; hover to restore the panel.

## Languages
20 interface languages, switchable live in Settings; Arabic mirrors the whole layout right-to-left automatically. Language packs are open JSON files - translators can edit and hit Reload.

## Data and backup
Everything lives in the portable Data folder next to the app. Settings > Data exports/imports a data package (a safety backup is made before any import). Scheduled automatic backups run every 24 hours by default (interval adjustable from 6 hours to 7 days, rolling retention) into Data\Backups.

## Screenshot
Press Ctrl+Alt+S or the screenshot button, select a region, then choose Save screenshot, Extract text, or Extract and translate. Enter saves; Esc or right-click cancels. Extraction does not save an entry or copy automatically. Copy source text and retry are explicit actions. OCR runs locally; only recognized text is sent to the configured translation provider when you choose translation. Install or repair components in Settings. Translation settings remain available even when the selection bubble is disabled.

## Check for updates
Use Check for updates in the application menu or Settings to contact GitHub on demand. Downloaded packages are verified before Restart and upgrade replaces application files in the same folder, preserving data, settings and installed components. If the check fails, retry or open the release page for a manual download. Version 1.2.1 must first be upgraded manually; the in-app flow is available from 1.2.2.
